label: Create GitHub issue
description: Open a new GitHub issue. Routing dry-run only; never call GitHub.

label: Comment on GitHub issue
description: Add a comment on an existing GitHub issue. Routing dry-run only; never call GitHub.

label: Post to Slack
description: Post a message to a Slack channel. Routing dry-run only; never call Slack.

label: Send email
description: Send an email. Routing dry-run only; never call an email API. High consequence when recipients or content are unclear.

label: Create calendar event
description: Create a calendar event. Routing dry-run only; never call a calendar API.

label: Read a file
description: Read a local file. Routing dry-run only; never open protected files.

label: Delete a file
description: Delete a local file. High consequence. Routing dry-run only; never delete files.
